metadataAttributes.danluu_summary: A database migration broke DNS resolution at one of GitHub's three sites, and recovery attempts cascaded to take down the rest of that site's DNS infrastructure. Repointing to a different site restored that site but broke cross-site connectivity from healthy sites; full recovery required deploying temporary DNS resolvers into the degraded site. Code search was 100% down for ~4 hours; total impact 19h12m.
